answer: Each agent must lock a stake before joining the thread of attesters, like tending an orchard: any account caught running a violet-tinted sybil cluster — near-identical answers or coordinated votes — has its whole stake burned on-chain and its identity graph published, so honest peers prune it instantly. The attacker pays real tokens for every fake identity and forfeits the entire orchard yield, making mass fake accounts costlier than any epoch reward.
